title: NO FITTED SHEET, MADE FOR A FUTON, NOT A BED.
text: NO FITTED SHEET, MADE FOR A FUTON, NOT A BED.. looks great on the bed. I don't really understand not having a fitted sheet and having a flat sheet instead. Even the flat sheet is not made for a bed, looks like its made for a futon too. It looks like it was made for a futon instead of a bed. With no fitted sheet, I've had to go out and buy fitted sheets to go with this.
